args.title: Fix rollup failure for users with invalid time zones
args.body:
File: src/notifications/rollup.ts

Handle cases where a user's time zone is invalid or incorrectly specified, such as "Central Standard Time", which causes the rollup process to fail for that user and all users after them in the list.
